item.title: How many days has AG Aaron Ford spent out of state? Here's what records show. - The Nevada Independent
item.description: A Nevada Independent review of his office calendars since 2019 found he spent at least 322 days out of state, mostly for professional conferences, including in Qatar, Israel and Geneva.

item.title: 'Awful lot of friends.' Landowner gets permission to develop private ski area in Rubies - The Nevada Independent
item.description: After failing in 2024 to convince the Elko Planning Commission to approve a public ski area, a California businessman and Elko County ranch owner has been OK'd to build a private facility on his sprawling ranch that extends into the Ruby Mountains.

item.title: Nevada's new state superintendent has set a vision for K-12 schools. Here are highlights. - The Nevada Independent
item.description: His priorities include ensuring students have strong academic foundations and access to college and career readiness classes.

item.title: Trabajadoras de burdel en Nevada están haciendo noticia. ¿Cómo funcionan esos burdeles legales? - The Nevada Independent
item.description: Nevada es el único estado en el país donde es legal pagar por servicios sexuales. Lea aquí cómo surgió la industria de los burdeles y cómo ha evolucionado.

item.title: Nevada utility to Lake Tahoe: Find electricity elsewhere - The Nevada Independent
item.description: Lake Tahoe's longtime power supplier, NV Energy, will cut off the region next year. The utility said that it wouldn't be able to continue this arrangement because of its "own resource needs." It has said data centers are driving "unprecedented" demand.

item.title: En Nevada abundan cámaras lectoras de placas de autos. El estado no las regula. - The Nevada Independent
item.description: Legisladores dijeron a The Nevada Independent que no ha sido fácil seguir el ritmo de la tecnología y que no está claro qué tan generalizados están realmente estos dispositivos. Información sobre la ubicación de las cámaras no está disponible públicamente.
